<div class="pron-rule-row">
<p>
<strong>
Long / short.
</strong>
Long forms stand alone, after prepositions, or for contrast. Short forms sit in the clitic chain.
</p>
<p>
<strong>
<i lang="sr">
svoj
</i>
</strong>
Use for own: my own, your own, his own, their own.
</p>
</div>

<div class="pron-rule-row">
<p>
<strong>
<i lang="sr">
Ovo je...
</i>
</strong>
neuter singular for “this is / that is”.
</p>
<p>
<strong>
<i lang="sr">
Ovaj pas
</i>
</strong>
match the noun by gender, number, and case.
</p>
</div>

<h4 class="chart-label">
Who / what
</h4>
<div class="pron-kw-table" role="table">
<div class="chart-label pron-kw-head" role="row">
<span role="columnheader">
</span>
<span role="columnheader">

what
</span>

</span>

</span>
</span>
<span class="chart-form" lang="sr" role="cell">
koga
</span>
